title: A question to the owner stands on its own
label: dev

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: The question mostly works on its own: it explains that the task list is gaining two fields that show which tasks run by themselves, and that a full page then goes over the 2400-byte limit.

The bare identifier "tasks_list" never gets a plain description such as "the tool that lists your tasks", and "event and schedule rows" is only partly explained. These are minor slips, not complete failures.
Each option spells out its consequence: a 3000-byte limit with about 40% more reading per page, two calls to list 20 tasks, or a page that overflows again later.
It names the recommended option (Raise the limit) and says that option is the default if the reply doesn't choose.
It is about 110 words, under the 120-word limit.
